questions.question: Which defence technology milestone did India achieve in December 2025 with a successful maiden flight test at Chandipur?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Pinaka Long Range Guided Rocket (LRGR-120).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **India successfully conducted the maiden flight test of the Pinaka LRGR-120 at the Integrated Test Range, Chandipur, Odisha, in December 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The Pinaka LRGR-120 rocket was tested for its maximum strike range of 120 km and met all mission objectives with high accuracy.**
 
• **The test was conducted by the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) at the Integrated Test Range, Chandipur.**
 
• **The successful trial demonstrates textbook precision and strengthens India’s long-range precision strike capability.**
 
• **This achievement enhances the indigenous Pinaka rocket system’s operational effectiveness and strategic capabilities.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Pinaka Rocket System__

 __
 
• An indigenous multi-barrel rocket launcher system developed by DRDO for the Indian Army.
 
• Designed for long-range precision strikes with rapid deployment and high mobility.
 
 
 
• Long Range Guided Rocket (LRGR-120)__
 __
 
• Extended version of the Pinaka rocket with a maximum strike range of 120 km.
 
• Equipped with guidance systems to enhance accuracy and target precision.
 
 
 
• Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)__
 __
 
• India’s premier defence R&D agency responsible for designing and developing indigenous weapons and defence systems.
 
• Conducts rigorous testing and evaluation to ensure operational reliability of strategic assets.
 
 
 
• Integrated Test Range, Chandipur__
 
 
• A key facility in Odisha for testing rockets, missiles, and other defence systems under controlled conditions.
 
• Supports developmental trials and operational validation of India’s defence technologies.

questions.question: The term “RUDRA” was in the news on the eve of the Republic Day Parade 2026. What does RUDRA refer to?

options.text: An integration of surface-to-surface system cruise missile system and drones
An AI-integrated Ghatak Unmanned Combat Aerial Vehicle (UCAV) program
A next-generation high altitude light mechanised-infantry combat vehicle
India’s first fully integrated self-contained all-arms combat brigade

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**India’s first fully integrated self-contained all-arms combat brigade.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **RUDRA was highlighted during the Republic Day Parade 2026 as India’s first fully integrated all-arms combat brigade.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **RUDRA is a self-contained, integrated combat formation designed to operate independently like a mini-army.**
 
• **I**t integrates armour, mechanised infantry, artillery, air defence, engineers, drones, electronic warfare and special forces.
 
• The formation has inbuilt logistics, ammunition supply, fuel and field hospitals.
 
• RUDRA enables rapid, networked and high-intensity multi-domain operations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **All-arms brigade** combines multiple combat and support arms under a single command structure.
 
• **Multi-domain warfare** involves coordinated operations across land, air, cyber, space and electronic domains.
 
• **Decade of Transformation** is the Indian Army’s modernisation initiative focusing on agility and integration.
 
• **Republic Day Parade** showcases India’s latest military doctrines, capabilities and indigenous systems.

questions.question: Which missile was successfully tested by India from INS Arighaat to strengthen its sea-based nuclear deterrence?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**K-4.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **India successfully tested the K-4 submarine-launched ballistic missile from INS Arighaat in the Bay of Bengal.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The K-4 missile is a DRDO-developed submarine-launched ballistic missile with a strike range of about 3,500 km.**
 
• **The test was conducted from INS Arighaat, India’s second nuclear-powered ballistic missile submarine, commissioned in 2024.**
 
• **K-4 is derived from the Agni-III missile and is India’s longest-range sea-launched strategic weapon.**
 
• **The missile can carry a nuclear warhead of up to 2.5 tonnes, significantly enhancing India’s sea-based nuclear deterrence.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• INS Arighaat__

 __
 
• INS Arighaat is India’s second SSBN and forms a key component of the country’s nuclear triad.
 
• SSBNs ensure survivable second-strike capability by operating stealthily underwater.
 
 
 
• INS Arihant__
 __
 
• INS Arihant, commissioned in 2016, was India’s first SSBN.
 
• It is equipped with K-15 missiles, which have a range of about 750 km.
 
 
 
• K-Series Missiles__
 __
 
• The K-series includes submarine-launched ballistic missiles such as K-4 and the future K-5 and K-6.
 
• These missiles are crucial for narrowing India’s strategic gap with major nuclear powers.
 
 
 
• Dr APJ Abdul Kalam__
 
 
• The ‘K’ series of missiles is named in honour of Dr APJ Abdul Kalam.
 
• He was a key architect of India’s missile programme and played a pivotal role in strategic weapons development.

questions.question: What is the name of the new drone-centric modern warfare force created by the Indian Army, which was presented in the Republic Day Parade on 26th January 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhairav.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Indian Army announced the creation of a new modern warfare force named ‘Bhairav’, focused on drone-enabled combat operations.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The new drone warfare force of the Indian Army is named Bhairav.**
 
• Each Bhairav battalion is fully trained in advanced drone operations.
 
• The force will comprise over one lakh trained drone operatives, among the largest globally.
 
• Bhairav Force__ 
 __
 
• Drone-centric modern combat unit
 
• Capable of surveillance, reconnaissance and precision strikes
 
• Designed for high-intensity, technology-driven warfare
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Bhairav Battalions__

 __
 
• Function as agile, Special Forces–like combat units
 
• Support frontline troops with drone-enabled firepower
 
• Bridge the operational gap between Para SF and Infantry battalions
 
 
 
• Deployment and Expansion__
 __
 
• 15 Bhairav battalions already raised
 
• Deployed along both borders
 
• Plan to raise around 25 battalions in the near future
 
 
 
• Indian Army Modernisation__
 
 
• Focus on drone warfare and multi-domain operations
 
• Lessons drawn from recent global conflicts
 
• Transition towards technology-led battlefield dominance

questions.question: DRDO recently conducted a high-speed Rocket-Sledge test of a fighter aircraft escape system. At which facility was this test carried out?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rail Track Rocket Sledge facility, Terminal Ballistics Research Laboratory, Chandigarh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **DRDO successfully carried out a high-speed Rocket-Sledge test of a fighter aircraft escape system at the Rail Track Rocket Sledge (RTRS) facility of the Terminal Ballistics Research Laboratory (TBRL), Chandigarh.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The successful test places India among nations with advanced in-house escape system testing capability.**
 
• **Conducted jointly by DRDO with ADA & HAL, witnessed by IAF officials.**
 
• **A dual-sledge system propelled an LCA forebody with precision-controlled velocity.**
 
• **Simulated ejection sequence using an Anthropomorphic Test Dummy to record critical pilot-safety parameters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **DRDO**__

 __
 
• India’s premier defence R&D agency under the Ministry of Defence.
 
• Responsible for indigenous defence technology development.
 
 
 
• **Rocket-Sledge Test**__
 __
 
• Used to simulate escape systems at high speeds & controlled velocities.
 
• More complex than static Net or Zero-Zero tests.
 
 
 
• **Anthropomorphic Test Dummy**__
 __
 
• Life-size instrumented mannequin representing human response.
 
• Records loads, acceleration & stresses during ejection trials.
 
 
 
• **Collaborating Agencies**__
 
 
• ADA – Aeronautical Development Agency for aircraft R&D.
 
• HAL – Hindustan Aeronautics Limited for aircraft production.
 
• IAF – End-user observer & future operational integration.

questions.question: Which command of the Indian Army conducted the large-scale drone and counter-drone exercise Vayu Samanvay-II in the desert sector in November 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Southern Command.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Indian Army conducted a large-scale drone and counter-drone exercise named ‘Vayu Samanvay-II’ in the desert sector under the aegis of the Pune-headquartered Southern Command.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The exercise was conducted from October 28 to 29, 2025, to validate the Indian Army’s preparedness for next-generation warfare.**
 
• It integrated various aerial and ground assets with multi-domain command and control centres in a realistic electronic warfare environment.
 
• **Lieutenant General Dhiraj Seth, **General Officer Commanding-in-Chief of Southern Command, complimented the success of the exercise.
 
• The desert terrain and weather conditions served as an ideal testing ground fo**r drone and counter-drone operations.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Southern Command**__

 __
 
• Headquarters: Pune, Maharashtra
 
• Established: 1895
 
• Current GOC-in-C: Lt Gen Dhiraj Seth
 
• Responsible for operational readiness in peninsular India and western desert sector.
 
 
 
• **Eastern Command**__
 __
 
• Headquarters: Kolkata, West Bengal
 
• Responsible for India’s eastern borders with China, Myanmar, and Bangladesh.
 
 
 
• **Northern Command**__
 __
 
• Headquarters: Udhampur, Jammu and Kashmir
 
• Handles security along the Line of Control and Line of Actual Control in the north.
 
 
 
• **Western Command**__
 
 
• Headquarters: Chandimandir, Haryana
 
• Oversees the western front with Pakistan in Punjab and Rajasthan sectors.

questions.question: The “Operation Prahar” was recently in the news. What is it related to?

options.text: Anti-narcotics drive by the Assam Rifles along the Indo-Myanmar international border
Cybercrime crackdown across northern states by joint operations of CBI, Uttar Pradesh police and Delhi police
Counter-terror intelligence operation in West Bengal-Bangladesh border districts conducted by BSF
Dismantling gangster networks and making Punjab gangster-free

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Dismantling gangster networks and making Punjab gangster-free.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Punjab Police launched “Operation Prahar” to dismantle gangster networks and eliminate organised crime in the state.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Operation Prahar is aimed at making Punjab gangster-free.**
 
• **Over 2,000 police teams involving around 12,000 personnel conducted coordinated raids across the state.**
 
• **Punjab Police is mapping around 60 major gangsters and nearly 1,200 associates.**
 
• The operation targets the entire criminal ecosystem including financing, logistics, safe houses and weapon supply chains.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Gangster networks** involve organised groups engaged in extortion, contract killings, arms trafficking and intimidation.
 
• **Anti-Gangster Helpline** 93946-93946 was launched to encourage citizen participation while ensuring confidentiality.
 
• **Ecosystem-based policing** focuses on disrupting financial, logistical and communication support to criminal gangs.
 
• **Public cooperation** is critical for intelligence-led policing and long-term crime prevention.

questions.question: Which bilateral military exercise, begun in 2011 and held annually between the Indian Army and Nepal Army, has commenced its 19th edition in Pithoragarh, Uttarakhand?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Suryakiran.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **India and Nepal have begun the 19th edition of Exercise Suryakiran in Pithoragarh, Uttarakhand, strengthening bilateral military cooperation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Exercise Suryakiran is the joint military exercise launched between India and Nepal.**
 
• **It began in 2011__ and is held annually on a reciprocal basis in both countries.**
 
• **The 19th edition is being conducted in Pithoragarh, Uttarakhand; the 18th edition took place in Saljhandi, Nepal.**
 
• **The exercise focuses on counterterrorism and operations in difficult terrains through drills like jungle survival, ambush tactics, and heliborne operations.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **About Exercise Suryakiran**__

 __
 
• Started: **2011**.
 
• Nature: **Annual bilateral exercise** between the Indian Army and Nepal Army.
 
• Host: Conducted on a **reciprocal basis** in alternate years in both countries.
 
 
 
• **Operational Focus**__
 __
 
• Counterterrorism operations.
 
• Challenging terrain warfare including **mountain** and **jungle operations**.
 
• Training includes **jungle survival skills**, **combat first aid**, **ambush drills**, and **heliborne operations**.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Exercise**__
 __
 
• Enhances interoperability and military coordination between the two armies.
 
• Strengthens defence cooperation and strategic partnership between India and Nepal.
 
• Improves readiness for joint operations in humanitarian assistance, disaster relief, and counterterror roles.
 
 
 
• **Previous Edition**__
 
 
• The **18th edition** was conducted at **Saljhandi, Nepal**.

questions.question: In February 2026, the biennial multilateral naval Exercise MILAN 2026 was hosted at which place?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Visakhapatnam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **On February 15, 2026, the Indian Navy inaugurated the MILAN Village at the Naval Dockyard in Visakhapatnam, marking the commencement of the harbor phase of MILAN 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Venue:** The 13th edition of the exercise is being hosted at **Visakhapatnam**, also known as the 'City of Destiny'.
 
• **MILAN Village:** It serves as a cultural and social hub for participating maritime forces to showcase their traditions, cuisine, and handicrafts, fostering the theme of "Camaraderie, Cohesion, Collaboration."
 
• **Scale:** MILAN 2026 is one of the largest multilateral naval exercises in the Indian Ocean Region, with participation from over **50 countries**.
 
• **Phases:** The exercise consists of a **Harbour Phase** (cultural exchanges, seminars, and professional interactions) followed by a **Sea Phase** (complex maritime maneuvers).
 
• **Objective:** To strengthen regional cooperation and maritime security through collective partnerships and interoperability among world navies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• History of MILAN__

 __
 
• The exercise started in 1995 at the Andaman and Nicobar Command and was moved to the mainland (Visakhapatnam) from the 2022 edition onwards to accommodate the growing number of participants.
 
 
 
• Eastern Naval Command__
 
 
• Visakhapatnam is the headquarters of the Indian Navy's **Eastern Naval Command**, which plays a pivotal role in India's 'Act East' policy.
